descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
To strengthen our Swiss-wide team, we are looking for 1. January 2027 for the Aargau/Solothurn region a proactive and independent machine and application technician ground systems (m/f), 80-100 %.

Their tasks

• Installation accompaniment for floor products on customer construction sites

• Product and machine instructions as well as carrying out product demonstrations at our customers

• Setting up our silos with the associated processing machines on the customer construction sites

• Performing miniature repairs on own Continue n silos as well as on silo accessories and processing machines on customer construction sites

Your profile

• Place of residence Mittelland (region Aargau / Solothurn)

• Training as a ground layer, bricklayer or plasterer, alternatively training as an electrician or mechanic with prior knowledge of processing equipment in the construction sector

• Floor screeds, balance masses, concrete products/concrete processing

• Flowing language skills in German

• Good user knowledge in MS Office

• Dynamic personality with motivation and commitment

• Independent working methods with “hands-on qualities”

• Ideally in possession of the truck driver's license Cat. C

Their perspectives

• Versatile area of responsibility in an international and yet family-owned company

• A corporate culture with space for personal responsibility and entrepreneurial ideas

• An environment in which openness and appreciation are a matter of course

• Attractive employment conditions with above-average social benefits

• Support for your personal development

More about us
"MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER HOME" - that's our purpose.
With our broad brand portfolio, we develop, produce and distribute materials and solutions for the construction sector and various industrial markets in a continuous innovation process.
As the world's leading manufacturer of building materials for high-quality building envelopes, special products and systems for building and civil engineering, plate laying solutions and innovative floor and wall constructions, Saint-Gobain Weber AG is committed to the people in their construction and living environment.
We are a subsidiary of the French global group Saint-Gobain. The group is committed to comfortable, energy-efficient and liveable buildings. In Switzerland, Saint-Gobain is represented alongside Weber with companies such as Rigips, ISOVER, Sanitas Troesch or Vetrotech.
Take a look at our website www.ch.weber.

To strengthen our concrete industry team in German-speaking Switzerland, we are looking for a proactive, customer-oriented individual for the position of:

Technical Sales Consultant, Concrete Industry, 100%

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Managing and further developing existing customers in the ready-mix concrete, precast concrete and concrete products industries

• Acquiring new customers and building long-term customer relationships in the Swiss concrete industry

• Providing technical advice and selling concrete admixtures, fibers, pigments and decorative concrete solutions

• Developing customer- and project-specific solutions in collaboration with Product Management and Research & Development

• Conducting product training sessions, customer seminars, trials and presentations

• Monitoring the market and competition and identifying new business opportunities

• Supporting product launches and actively contributing to the further development of Concrete - Concrete industry - Businesses in Switzerland

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed training as a concrete technologist, construction materials tester or civil engineer, or a comparable qualification, with work experience in the concrete industry

• Several years of experience in the ready-mix concrete, precast concrete and/or concrete products industries

• A proven track record in technical sales, customer consulting or business development

• Good knowledge of the Swiss concrete and building materials sector, as well as a strong technical understanding

• Entrepreneurial, independent and customer-oriented working style with a persuasive presence

• Very good German language skills; knowledge of French and/or English is an advantage

• Willingness to travel within Switzerland

YOUR PROSPECTS

• A position of responsibility with considerable scope for shaping the role in an international company focused on Switzerland

• Technically sophisticated and innovative products, as well as direct contact with decision-makers in the concrete industry

• A corporate culture that leaves room for personal responsibility, collaboration and entrepreneurial ideas

• An environment where openness and appreciation are a matter of course

• Attractive employment conditions with above-average social benefits, including a company vehicle, as well as ongoing education and training
